items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: No. Sonny Greer had left for a while. He had Charlie Smith. ... Sonny Greer. I loved him. He fit that band to a tee, that early band. Last time I saw him, he had been out of the band. ctx.x: You were replacing Sonny Greer? Or not?
